checks.explanation: Microsoft launched the new Bing with GPT-4/ChatGPT built in on February 7, 2023, and it had a significant, well-documented impact on Google: Google's stock fell about 8% after a stumbled Bard announcement, internal 'code red' urgency was widely reported, and Bing's mobile app downloads surged roughly 8x, closely matching the prediction (though Bing's overall search market share remained small relative to Google's).

sources.title: Microsoft launches the new Bing, with ChatGPT built in
